title: Get started with zuspark
text: spark_connect() takes sc:// connection string, default one SPARK_REMOTE environment variable. local Spark Connect server listens port 15002. Parameters go ;. token sends bearer token turns TLS ; parameter zuspark doesn’t recognise sent request header.

title: Get started with zuspark
text: spark_sql() sends statement. query comes back zuspark_query, holds plan rows yet; nothing read ask . Commands DDL, DML SET run , spark_sql() returns rows produce data frame.
code: q <- spark_sql(con, "SELECT id, id * 2 AS twice FROM range(10)") spark_schema(q) spark_sql(con, "CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW small AS SELECT * FROM range(5)")

title: Get started with zuspark
text: spark_collect() runs query returns one data frame. Types R can’t hold exactly, BIGINT beyond 2^53, error default; lossy chooses text widened type instead. spark_fetch() returns result Arrow stream instead, code consumes Arrow directly.
code: # Open: whether spark_collect() returns a plain data frame or a zutable # (the design proposes plain, unless a consumer asks). spark_collect(q) spark_collect(q, lossy = "character") stream <- spark_fetch(q)
